versions.changelog:
Initial public release with detailed safety-focused workflow and cross-platform capability.

- Scans and analyzes file/folder structure in read-only mode by default.
- Identifies duplicate files without deleting; generates a clear report first.
- Suggests organizational layouts and specific cleanup actions, executing only after explicit user confirmation.
- Enforces strict safety guardrails: backups, small batches, always use system recycle bin, never permanent delete.
- Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux with platform-specific commands; all actions are confirmed step-by-step.
